name: minimind
description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
one_liner: A teaching kit that lets you train your own tiny AI language model from scratch on a single ordinary computer in about two hours.
buyer: An AI bootcamp instructor or corporate ML trainer who needs a hands-on exercise that doesn't require expensive GPUs.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp adds a 'build your own LLM' module using this so students train a real (if tiny) model instead of just calling an API.
A company runs an internal AI-literacy workshop for non-ML engineers, using it to demystify how language models actually work.
A hobbyist builds and sells a tiny domain-specific model (e.g. a toy chatbot for a niche fandom) as a portfolio piece to land AI job interviews.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid 'train your first LLM in a weekend' course built around this repo.
Offer corporate workshops that use it as the hands-on lab exercise.

steal_this: Turn it into a polished weekend course: record yourself training a small model live, package the notebook, and sell it to AI-curious engineers for $49.
